summary: This standards-track RFC describes using stateless IP/ICMP translation in IPv6 data centers. IPv4-only clients on the Internet are translated to IPv6 at the edge of the operator's network, and from there the data center can run IPv6 only, simplifying operations.

eli5.summary: Visitors speaking an old language are met at the door by a translator. Inside the building, everyone just uses the new language.

questions: ipv6 only data center with ipv4 clients
